child_rule: null for parent or fixed wire error; otherwise exact current broker kind, ordinal1..4 and accepted parent receipt IDs. Nonce is32lowerhex, decisions64lowerhex, parent action choose:0..7.
request_rule: GET requires no body. POST contains exactly these keys; child null for parent or exact last published child correlation. Duplicate/unknown keys, wrong stage/kind/ordinal/receipt and unpublished actions reject before dispatch and terminalize the service.
prior_result_rule: Always present; null initially, otherwise exact last accepted parent receipt. option_transition has null child; child_completed has the completed exact child envelope; map_handoff has null child. The same prior_result may repeat until another accepted parent action.

child_payloads.item: Inner payload object and field order byte-equivalent to the frozen item_probe_v1/item_v1 codec for actual ItemV1Session values; the enclosing response envelope is new.
child_payloads.card_selection: Inner payload object and field order byte-equivalent to the frozen card_selection_v1 child codec for actual CardSelectionV1Session values; no card parent controller; the enclosing response envelope is new.

child_read_rule: When no active child is latched, Parent.Read may admit one; require exact ActiveChild/correlation and emit its first typed payload. While a child is active, read and emit that broker directly without Parent.Read. Latch resolved_payload_emitted only after successfully encoding and returning the first validated resolved child payload. On a subsequent GET only, call Parent.Read to consume/dispose that child and resume the parent. Failed encoding is terminal. A request cannot choose/create a child; stale envelope, kind, ordinal, receipt and broker identities reject.
provider_rule: run_event(request, *, provider, clock, sleep) requires provider(DecisionView) -> actionID; DecisionView has kind, deeply immutable payload and immutable child correlation. Invoke once per decision, validate exact legal membership and same overall deadline before POST. Controller reentry terminal. Explicit first_legal provider is available for fixtures.
retention: Only fixed sanitized summary fields retained. Option text, card identifiers, wire bodies and provider decisions remain transient; mutable transport buffers cleared in finally.
parent_failure_rule: Outer child must be null; status failed; code from the closed parent_failure_codes set only.
internal_parent_child_signal: Parent status=child/phase=child is internal admission only and must never be serialized as an external parent payload.
provider_correlation_rule: DecisionView child is null iff kind=parent; otherwise its kind equals the exact active envelope child kind.
child_policy_rule: Proceed uses empty policy and domain0. Ordinary item uses item_reward and domain0. Known unsupported card uses unsupported_card and domain0, preserves the native enabled fact and is absent from legal_actions. Every supported card policy must be an exact immutable compiled catalog entry for the candidate stable_id, with child_domain_count1..64 inside its proven domain bounds; unknown policy IDs reject. Separate accepted caller-selection evidence owns the closed production catalog.
candidate_digest_rule: Append child_domain_count as one unsigned big-endian32 integer immediately after child_policy in both canonical structural and full decision projections. Policy and concrete pre-dispatch domain cannot change under an accepted action.
card_validation_rule: Retain the catalog definition and concrete domain of the accepted parent action before child admission. Every ready child must match its exact operation/min/max/commit and candidate count; candidate identity remains immutable. Selected slots equal accepted select receipts. Preview and confirmation legality follows the frozen card core, including automatic single selection preview. Resolved operation and selected originals/count equal the accepted selection history; preview/confirm receipts do not count as selected cards. No phase/action/history regression or retry.
catalog_rule: Production catalog has only reviewed rows. Generic inert fixtures may provide internal synthetic definitions through a test-only constructor; the public service and run_event entry points use the production catalog. No runtime file, route, provider output or environment variable can extend it.
